title: My Daughter-In-Law Stole $225K In Fake Claims And Left Me A Clawback. So I Recovered It All
description: At 59, I trusted my daughter-in-law to handle Medicare reconciliation for the pharmacy I bought with $132,000 of my pension. She filed $225,000 in fake claims, left me with a $4,300 clawback notice, and never expected me to audit every remittance report. Now she counts penicillin capsules in a smock that says 'Dispensed My Trust' while every label prints her federal fraud docket number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #PharmacyJustice
thumb_text: SHE STOLE $225K, SO I RECOVERED EVERY CENT
pinned_comment: If my daughter-in-law filed $225,000 in fake Medicare claims under my NPI number and left me with a $4,300 clawback, I would have gone straight to CMS with the remittance reports. What would you have done the moment you saw that notice? Tell me your story in the comments.
